description: Divisional Secretariat Matara - Notifying that the Annual Festival of Mother's National Church of Matara will be conducted from 03.09.2015 to 13.09.2015
categorisation: This gazette content announces the dates for an annual religious festival (Mother's National Church, Matara) under the authority of the Pilgrimage Ordinance (Chapter 175). It is a legal notification made under specific regulations and published as an official notice, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or any other specialized category.
